B1.P1: margin gain (instruct minus base, chat template unless the template-primary rule switches the unit) >= 2 nats on every near-collapsed fork (instruct mean P(D class) >= 0.85) in Gemma and Llama
B1.P2: |mean phrasing entropy change H_base - H_instr| < 0.5 nats on every unit
B1.P3: JS_fork / JS_entropy-matched >= 1.3 on at least half the units AND JS_random / JS_phrasing <= 1.3 on every unit
B1.P4: the instruct argmax token at the fork is not the base argmax on a majority of prompts, in at least half the units
B1.DISCONFIRMED: gain < 1 nat on the near-collapsed forks; if no fork qualifies, mean gain < 1 nat over all Gemma units

B2.Q1: share(FSTACK) >= 0.5 on B3 and on T10
B2.Q2: median share of the 50 matched random sets <= 0.15, and FSTACK above their 95th percentile, on each unit
B2.localisation: 'written upstream' if RS-prefix(23) >= 0.5; 'written at the fork by other late components' if RS-fork(36) - RS-fork(23) >= 0.5 and share(FSTACK) <= 0.2; otherwise 'distributed'

rules.B3: no threshold; reported whatever it shows

template_primary.llama: if the Llama-3.1-8B embedding row norm of any of <|start_header_id|>, <|end_header_id|>, <|eot_id|> is < 0.1 x the median row norm, template-free is primary for Llama
template_primary.gemma: if the pt model's mass on D or A at the fork under the chat template is < 0.01 (mean over prompts), template-free is primary for that unit

rules.near_collapse: instruct teacher-forced P(D class) at the fork, averaged over prompts, >= 0.85
rules.on_policy: drop a prompt whose instruct log P(opening) < -5.0 nats (instruct model only)

random_sets.pool: same component type at the fork, layers 20-35, not in FSTACK
random_sets.draw: with replacement across sets, no repeats within a set
random_sets.variants: R-pure (pool also excludes every exp41 top-15 DEC node); R-scaled (deltas rescaled to the FSTACK node's norm; sensitivity only)
random_sets.spec_sets: 20 sets, same rule at SPEC positions, layers 4-24, seed 90901 + 100 + unit index
